data.note: Player chooses Protector or Thaumaturge at L1. Protector grants heavy armor + martial weapon proficiency; Thaumaturge grants an extra cantrip + proficiency in one INT-based skill (Arcana/History/Nature/Religion). v0 stores the pick as a flag; the proficiency/cantrip grants aren't yet wired in.
Uses per short rest scale with cleric level: 2 at L2, 3 at L6, 4 at L18. v0 uses a static 2; engine doesn't yet support a perClass+table for activity uses (only triggers in derive.ts plumbing).
Consumes a Channel Divinity use; undead in range make a Wisdom save (spell DC) or are turned for 1 minute. v0 surfaces the save action; the resource accounting lives on the Channel Divinity activity.
Placeholder for Divine Domain selection (Life / Light / Trickery / War in 2024 SRD 5.2). The chosen subclass slug lives on character.classes[].subclass.

SRD 5.2: Whenever you use Turn Undead, roll a number of d8s equal to your Wisdom modifier; each undead that fails its save takes Radiant damage equal to the total. The die count is wismod (dynamic), not a fixed 2d8. The engine's damage parts schema only accepts a static dice string; surfaced as a trait tag so the UI can prompt the player to roll the correct number of d8s manually.

activities.name: Sear Undead
activities.note: On Turn Undead, roll (Wisdom modifier) d8s. Each undead failing the Turn Undead save takes that much Radiant damage. Track Wisdom modifier to determine the number of dice.
